fieldNotes.location: LOW-CONFIDENCE LOCATION. Roster coords (45.675694,-94.807948) for '123 5th Ave E' landed in downtown Melrose with no plant. The large food-processing complex at ~45.6705,-94.800 was positively identified by StreetView signage as a LAND O'LAKES Inc. plant, not Jennie-O. The audited building is the next-largest modern processing plant on the NE edge of Melrose by the Sauk River (~45.6763,-94.7942) -- a large single-building plant with numbered truck drive-in bays (1B-5B), dock doors with trailers, an E-side trailer drop yard, and a perimeter loop drive. This best matches the new $137M / ~300k-sq-ft Jennie-O Melrose plant profile but could NOT be confirmed by signage; treat the identity as unverified.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Open site -- StreetView shows no perimeter fence and no gate/barrier at the plant approach. Classified false but flagged given the location uncertainty.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth visible at any approach.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: A perimeter loop drive and large paved yard give a long approach able to stack 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Rows of untethered trailers on the E side of the building -> dropYard true; dropArea 10-25.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: ~22 doors estimated: numbered drive-in bays plus dock doors with trailers backed in; banded 10-25, low-confidence.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide open paved yard and loop drive leave ample room for an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Melrose is a small rural city (~3,700); the plant is on the NE edge by the Sauk River and farmland -> Rural.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: One main processing building plus a detached SW building (~2); uncertain.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Could not confirm separate ship/receive dock banks from imagery -> classified false, flagged.
